Lina Park: Quick alert  several EU trial signups report "stuck indexing" and delayed activation emails. I exported 57 affected tenants. Need short customer note + standard credit.

Marcus Flynn: Infra update: small downstream 5xx burst + aggressive client retries caused consumer lag on index-writer. We applied retry caps and scaled consumers at 3187654600. ETA drain ~30-45m.

Olga Petrova: Draft customer note below (short + clear CTA).

Olga Petrova: "Hello  we're sorry for the interruption. A subset of EU trials may see delayed activation and partial search results while we clear an indexing backlog. Engineers applied mitigations and we expect recovery within 1 hour.

Impacted trials will receive a $175 account credit automatically. To request prioritized help, book a 1:1: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

We will follow up with a full RCA.  Redwood Support"

Lina Park: Standard credit $175 for trials <6 months. Manual backfills only for high-touch renewals. I'll DM AEs for any >$12k ARR accounts.

Marcus Flynn: Deploy link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/roll/retry-cap-110  success @3187654922. Queue drain: 50% @15m, 92% @38m.

DeployBot: Roll/retry-cap-110 completed  4 instances updated  3187654922

CS Bot: Incident INC-6102 recorded  affected=57  status=mitigated  office hours link attached.

Lina Park: Sending first wave to affected trials (email + in-app) now. Will update status page once drain = 100% and follow up with RCA + renewal comms within 24h.

Marcus Flynn: Full drain at 3187656000. No data loss detected. We will add consumer-lag alerting and GC tuning to the postmortem.

Olga Petrova: Thanks team. I'll attach a short feedback survey post-recovery and track responses for renewal conversations. :pray:
